title: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker pyromancer stranded on Amonkhet after a crash, who confides her fears about Nissa to her mother and a god.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother and a former rebel who helps rebuild the rocket car and comforts Chandra.

entities.name: Daretti
entities.description: A goblin engineer who tends to the concussed crew and builds a new engine from palm fibers and hippo bones.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A small glowing-tailed creature who senses Omenpaths and whom Winter used to find shortcuts.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Chandra's girlfriend, who lost Zendikar and a spark and whom Chandra wants to help.

entities.name: Kolodin
entities.description: Cloudspire's mechanically skilled captain whom Chandra recalls.

entities.name: Saheeli
entities.description: A friend of Pia who once theorized about planetary travel.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon who killed Amonkhet's gods but could not strangle their spirit.

entities.name: Ketramose
entities.description: A lion-masked, golden-bowed god of Amonkhet who appears to Chandra at the oasis and gives directions.

entities.name: Sita Varma
entities.description: The masked racer who crashes in sight of the finish line and is unmasked in front of her father.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: Captain of the Speed Demons, who races Spitfire and is captured by Vraska and Jace.

entities.name: Mohar Varma
entities.description: Sita's father, a consul who sees her unmasked and orders silence about it.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon who tears Winter from his wreck and seeks Loot.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage who compels Winter and decides to take him prisoner as a loose end.

entities.name: Kari Zev
entities.description: Race celebrity honored by a statue on the course.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A figure whose dying screams haunt Chandra's dreams.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin friend of Chandra whose lion head Chandra compares to the god's mask.

entities.name: Speed Demons
entities.description: Winter's team with glitching vehicle.

entities.name: Aether Rangers
entities.description: Spitfire's team.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The desert plane where the crew crashes at an oasis.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: The home plane of the Nalaars and the Varmas where the race ends.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city hosting the finish line.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nissa's favorite place in the Multiverse.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Planar routes between worlds, including the one Loot senses nearby.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: The multiplanar race whose finish is in Ghirapur.

events.summary: The rocket car spirals out of the Omenpath above an oasis on Amonkhet instead of reaching Avishkar.
events.quote: the rocket car spirals into the air above an oasis on Amonkhet

events.summary: Chandra blasts the ground with fire, boiling the oasis water.
events.quote: she blasts the ground ahead of them with a gout of fire.

events.summary: The car crashes into the oasis.
events.quote: An instant later, the ship hits the earth.

events.summary: Chandra wakes first, concussed, and checks on the others.
events.quote: Chandra's the first one to wake beneath the warm sun of Amonkhet.

events.summary: Daretti offers medicine for the concussions and hands Chandra a cup.
events.quote: If you need medicine, I've plenty.

events.summary: Daretti concludes the engine is blown and they must improvise from scrap.
events.quote: I regret to inform you we've blown the engine.

events.summary: Pia assigns Chandra to be her welding torch.
events.quote: are going to be your dear sweet mother's personal welding torch.

events.summary: Daretti, Pia and Chandra build an all-new engine from palm fibers, hippo bones and scrap.
events.quote: I believe we're developing an all-new type of engine here, purely out of desperation.

events.summary: Daretti takes over the night work on the engine.
events.quote: I think that's most of the welding work done for the evening.

events.summary: Loot encourages Chandra that when you see something wrong you fix it.
events.quote: When you see things that are wrong, you fix them.

events.summary: Pia asks why Chandra did not race with the Aether Rangers.
events.quote: why didn't you want to race with us?

events.summary: Chandra confides she feared losing Nissa's second chance at a spark and fears telling her she failed.
events.quote: We can't lose her second chance at a spark, too.

events.summary: Pia comforts Chandra, saying they improvise and find other ways when things do not work out.
events.quote: We find other ways to be.

events.summary: A lion-masked god appears beside Chandra at the oasis in the night.
events.quote: a very tall, powerfully built man with a lion's head.

events.summary: The god explains that Bolas could not kill the spirit of Amonkhet's gods.
events.quote: Bolas thought he had strangled our spirit within his claws, but what do you see around you?

events.summary: The god asks only to hear of other worlds in return for his counsel.
events.quote: It would delight me if you told me of the other worlds, about how they live and in what they believe.

events.summary: Chandra tells the god about Zendikar, her girlfriend's favorite place.
events.quote: my girlfriend's favorite place in the Multiverse is called Zendikar.

events.summary: Spitfire races through the Omenpath into Ghirapur, leading the field to the finish.
events.quote: As her ride howls through the Omenpath, there is nothing to hamper her.

events.summary: Spitfire and Winter go chassis to chassis near the finish.
events.quote: The Aether Ranger's front bumper scrapes against the Speed Demon's driver-side door.

events.summary: Winter fires blue flame at Spitfire and bursts into flame.
events.quote: Winter shoots a gout of blue flame at her.

events.summary: A golden filigree safety wall shoots up in the track, ahead of the finish line.
events.quote: Shooting up in the middle of the track is an intricate wall of golden filigree

events.summary: Spitfire crashes into the wall, knocked dazed.
events.quote: Stars explode across the back of her eyes

events.summary: Half of Spitfire's mask falls into her lap, revealing her to guards as Sita.
events.quote: For there in her lap is half of Spitfire's mask.

events.summary: Guards drag her before her father, who demands to know the meaning of this.
events.quote: Sita! Are you all right? What is the meaning of this? You could have been killed out there!

events.summary: Mohar orders his daughter taken to a doctor and tells his men to keep it secret.
events.quote: Tell no one of this.

events.summary: Vraska pulls Winter from the Speed Demons' wreck.
events.quote: Vraska tears Winter from the wreckage.

events.summary: Jace compels Winter to go limp and searches his mind for Loot.
events.quote: With another wave of his hand, Jace compels him to go limp.

events.summary: Vraska says they promised to keep Loot safe.
events.quote: We promised to keep him safe.

events.summary: Jace decides to take Winter prisoner as a loose end.
events.quote: I think we need to take him prisoner.

events.summary: Pia hot-wires the cobbled-together car.
events.quote: Pia's rubbing two wires together beneath the steering wheel.

events.summary: Chandra says Ketramose gave directions to an Omenpath.
events.quote: Ketramose said if we head this way for an hour or two, we should see it

events.summary: Chandra realizes Winter used Loot to find secret Omenpaths as shortcuts.
events.quote: He made you show him where the other Omenpaths are, the ones nobody else knows about.

relations.quote: my girlfriend's favorite place in the Multiverse is called Zendikar.
We're going to take care of everything. I promise.
It gladdens my heart to have helped you

relations.note: Vraska pulls him from the wreck.
relations.quote: Vraska tears Winter from the wreckage.
